name: Hitevision Co., Ltd.
summary: Hitevision Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of interactive display products in China and internationally. Its products primarily include interconnected intelligent interactive blackboards/smart interactive whiteboards, recording and broadcasting hosts, video display stands, teaching terminals, electronic class signs, interactive recording and broadcasting equipment, and other hardware devices for primary and secondary schools, higher vocational schools, preschool education, and other educational markets.
